about: Tester replies and the scores Jev (jev-1.14.0, 2026-11-15) returned for them with the four questions in src/engine/verdict/questions.ts. Jev is not deterministic: each reply was judged 5 times with identical requests and every sample is kept; a reply must get its verdict on EVERY sample (alsoAllowed lists the one known exception). unverifiedLocalCheck is the PM's label. finalStepVerdict is what decideStepVerdict must return on a final step. previousSingleQuestionSamples are the scores of the question the local-check question replaced (vibesync-9lzk.61), from a separate run the same day. Replies named 'variant:' are the soak-run-3 reply with its last sentence changed; the rest are real.
